targets.rawSql:
SELECT value AS "HR bpm"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'hr'
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
ORDER BY ts_ms DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT value AS "SpO2 %"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'spo2'
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
ORDER BY ts_ms DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT value AS steps
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'steps'
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
ORDER BY ts_ms DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT value AS "walk cm"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'walk_cm'
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
ORDER BY ts_ms DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(value / 10.0, 1) AS "kcal"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'kcal_x10'
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
ORDER BY ts_ms DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(value / 1000.0, 2) AS "metres"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'distance_mm'
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
ORDER BY ts_ms DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ts_ms AS time, value AS "HR"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'hr'
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
  AND ts_ms >= $__from AND ts_ms <= $__to
ORDER BY ts_ms

SELECT ts_ms AS time, value AS "SpO2"

SELECT ts_ms AS time, value AS "walk_cm"

  AND ts_ms >= $__from AND ts_ms <= $__to

SELECT ts_ms AS time, (value / 10.0) AS "kcal"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'kcal_x10'
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')

SELECT ts_ms AS time, (value / 1000.0) AS "metres"

WHERE kind = 'distance_mm'

SELECT value AS "ESP dBm"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'rssi_esp'

ORDER BY ts_ms DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT value AS "MT200 dBm"

  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
ORDER BY ts_ms DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ts_ms AS time, value AS "esp_phone"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'rssi_esp'
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
  AND ts_ms >= $__from AND ts_ms <= $__to
ORDER BY ts_ms

SELECT ts_ms AS time, value AS "mt200_esp"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE kind = 'rssi_mt200'
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
  AND ts_ms >= $__from AND ts_ms <= $__to
ORDER BY ts_ms

SELECT ts_ms AS time, (recv_ms - ts_ms) AS "lag_ms"
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE recv_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
  AND ts_ms >= $__from AND ts_ms <= $__to
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Wearable create→cloud lag (ms; empty on historical rows)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source AS device_kind, device_id, kind,
  to_timestamp(ts_ms/1000.0) AS created,
  to_timestamp(recv_ms/1000.0) AS delivered,
  (recv_ms - ts_ms) AS lag_ms,
  payload_bytes AS bytes,
  CASE WHEN kind LIKE 'rssi%' THEN value END AS rssi_dbm
FROM wearable_samples
WHERE ('${device:raw}' = 'All' OR device_id = '${device:raw}')
  AND ts_ms >= $__from AND ts_ms <= $__to
ORDER BY ts_ms DESC
LIMIT 5000
